# Requirements Quality Checklist: Plataforma Social de Catálogo

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade escrita dos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais do feature de catálogo social de filmes/séries.
**Created**: 2026-11-18
**Feature**: `specs/001-catalog-rate-review/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are authorization boundaries fully specified for create/edit/delete actions across catálogo, avaliação e resenha? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004, §FR-006, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 Are required data attributes for autoria, data e identificação de mídia explicitly documented for all public review/rating outputs? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define requirements for how existing avaliações/resenhas are handled when um item é removido do catálogo pessoal? [Gap, Coverage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the initial status value for newly saved media explicitly defined with canonical value mapping (labels vs internal enum)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is “mensagens claras de erro” quantified with objective criteria (conteúdo mínimo, contexto e ação de retry)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Is “conclusão por teclado dos fluxos principais” defined with explicit completion criteria per fluxo? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do public visibility requirements remain consistent between FRs and assumptions for usuários autenticados vs visitantes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Are single-active-record rules consistent across catálogo, avaliação e resenha requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-009, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Are series-scope statements consistent across clarifications, functional requirements, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-015, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Are acceptance scenarios for each user story objective and verifiable without inferred behavior? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1-3]
- [ ] CHK011 Do success criteria define measurement method, sample definition, and observation window? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003, §SC-004, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Is each functional requirement traceable to at least one acceptance scenario or measurable outcome? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001..016, §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are alternate-flow requirements documented for “primeiro salvamento” versus “item já salvo” paths? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Are exception-flow requirements specified for mutation attempts by non-authenticated visitors? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Are recovery requirements defined for transient external catalog failures beyond a single retry attempt? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are idempotency/duplicate-submission requirements specified for repeated save/rate/review requests in short intervals? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are rating boundary conditions fully specified for values outside 1..5 and non-integer inputs? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Are review length boundaries clearly defined for exactly 20/2000 characters and whitespace-only input? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 Are performance requirements for busca/salvar/avaliar/resenhar explicitly quantified in the feature requirements? [Gap, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK020 Are accessibility requirements beyond keyboard (focus visibility, accessible names, feedback announcements) explicitly specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Are resilience requirements for OMDb timeout, invalid payload, and rate limiting explicitly documented? [Coverage, Gap, Constitution §Core Principle V]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Are external dependency contracts (OMDb and JSON Server) explicitly linked to corresponding feature requirements? [Dependency, Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK023 Are assumptions validated, constrained, or flagged for follow-up where they materially affect acceptance? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is API secret handling (environment variable only, no repository exposure) captured as an explicit requirement? [Gap, Constitution §Padrões Técnicos]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK025 Are out-of-scope social features (seguir/curtidas/comentários) bounded by explicit non-goals to prevent requirement drift? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the terms “mídia salva”, “item ativo” e “resenha ativa” defined without semantic overlap? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-009, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK027 Are potential conflicts between local persistence constraints and public visibility requirements explicitly resolved? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
